implemented_correction: Masked -9999 and NaN before scoring; applied 8-connected Moore neighborhood median (>=4), mean (1-3), neutral constants (0); set ml_cooling_eligible=False

implemented_correction: Filtered exclusively to valid observations with OBS >= 2; enforced N_valid >= 4; rejected single-year spikes across >=2 calendar years
